f.title: Submit each ADR report with a cover letter and an E2B electronic report on CD
f.statement: When submitting an adverse drug reaction report to CInMED (on the Institute's form or a CIOMS form), the company must attach an appropriate cover letter and the electronic report in E2B format burned on a CD.
f.systems: ICH E2B; CIOMS I form; CInMED ADR form; CD

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (or MA applicant) in Montenegro, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: Uz prijavu (popunjenu na obrascu Instituta za ljekove i medicinska sredstva (CInMED) ili CIOMS obrascu) je potrebno priložiti odgovarajuće propratno pismo i elektronsku prijavu (E2B format) narezanu na CD.
rows.review_note: Review: 'je potrebno' (it is necessary) read as mandatory. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en.
rows.quote_en: Together with the report (completed on the form of the Institute for Medicines and Medical Devices (CInMED) or on the CIOMS form), it is necessary to attach an appropriate cover letter and the electronic report (E2B format) burned on a CD.

f.title: Have the cover letter signed by the PV responsible person in Montenegro (or the notified back-up)
f.statement: The cover letter must be signed by the person responsible for pharmacovigilance in Montenegro. In that person's absence, the letter may be signed by the back-up responsible person, provided the details of the back-up's appointment have been submitted to the Institute.
f.exceptions: Back-up responsible person may sign in the QPPV's absence only if the back-up appointment was notified to the Institute.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (or MA applicant) in Montenegro, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: Propratno pismo mora biti potpisano od strane odgovorne osobe za farmakovigilancu u Crnoj Gori. U odsustvu odgovorne osobe, pismo može biti potpisano od strane back-up odgovorne osobe, ukoliko su podaci o imenovanju back-up dostavljeni Institutu;
rows.review_note: Review: 'mora' = must; back-up permission kept as exception. Translation check: agrees.
rows.quote_en: The cover letter must be signed by the person responsible for pharmacovigilance in Montenegro. In the absence of the responsible person, the letter may be signed by the back-up responsible person, if the details of the back-up's appointment have been submitted to the Institute;

f.title: Submit a late E2B report afterwards, referencing the earlier paper report's registry number
f.statement: If the E2B report cannot be submitted within the statutory deadline for submitting reports to the Institute (15 days for serious and 90 days for non-serious adverse reactions), the paper report (Institute or CIOMS form) is submitted within the deadline and the E2B report is submitted subsequently, quoting the number under which the previously submitted report was registered.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (or MA applicant) in Montenegro, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.deadline: Paper report within the statutory deadline: 15 days (serious), 90 days (non-serious); E2B may follow later
rows.quote: Ukoliko E2B prijavu nije moguće dostaviti u zakonskom roku za dostavljanje prijava Institutu (15 dana za ozbiljna i 90 dana za neželjena dejstva koja nijesu ozbiljnog kaktera) E2B prijava se dostavlja naknadno, uz poziv na broj pod kojim je zavedena prethodno dostavljena prijava (popunjena na obrascu Instituta ili CIOMS obrascu);
data_elements: registry number of the earlier report
rows.review_note: Review: the 15/90-day deadlines are restated from the law, with no clock-start wording in this instruction, so no deadline_rule. Translation check: agrees ('kaktera' typo kept in quote).
rows.quote_en: If the E2B report cannot be submitted within the statutory deadline for submitting reports to the Institute (15 days for serious and 90 days for adverse reactions that are not of a serious character), the E2B report is submitted subsequently, with reference to the number under which the previously submitted report (completed on the Institute form or the CIOMS form) was registered;

f.title: State the suspect product trade name and the submitting company on the cover letter
f.statement: The cover letter must clearly state the subject, i.e. the trade (proprietary) name of the suspect medicinal product, and the name of the company submitting the report.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (or MA applicant) in Montenegro, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: Na propratnom pismu jasno navesti naziv predmeta tj. zaštićeni naziv suspektnog lijeka i naziv kompanije koja dostavlja prijavu;
rows.review_note: Review: instruction in the imperative infinitive ('navesti'), read as mandatory for the Institute's filing. Translation check: agrees.
rows.quote_en: On the cover letter, clearly state the subject, i.e. the proprietary name of the suspect medicine and the name of the company submitting the report;

f.title: Indicate on the cover letter whether the report is initial or follow-up
f.statement: The cover letter must clearly state whether the report is an initial (first) report or a follow-up report.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (or MA applicant) in Montenegro, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: Na propratnom pismu jasno navesti da li se radi o inicijalnoj (prvoj) ili follow-up prijavi;
rows.review_note: Review: as point 3. Translation check: agrees.
rows.quote_en: On the cover letter, clearly state whether it is an initial (first) or a follow-up report;

f.title: Number follow-up reports and reference the initial report on the cover letter
f.statement: For a follow-up report, the cover letter must give the follow-up number (first follow-up, second follow-up, ...) and must refer to the initial report (name and registry/file number) to which the follow-up relates.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (or MA applicant) in Montenegro, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: Ukoliko se radi o follow up prijavi, na propratnom pismu navesti broj follow-up prijave (prva follow-up, druga follow-up...) i obavezno se pozvati na inicijalnu prijavu (naziv i djelovodni broj) na koju se dostavljena follow-up prijava odnosi;
data_elements: initial report name and registry number
rows.review_note: Review: 'obavezno' (mandatorily) supports Mandatory. Translation check: agrees.
rows.quote_en: If it is a follow-up report, state on the cover letter the number of the follow-up report (first follow-up, second follow-up...) and mandatorily refer to the initial report (name and registry number) to which the submitted follow-up report relates;

f.title: State the report source, primary reporter and study name on the cover letter
f.statement: The cover letter must clearly state the source of the report (spontaneous report, report from a non-interventional study, literature or other) and, for medically confirmed reports, the details of the primary reporter. For a report from a study, the exact name of the study must also be given.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (or MA applicant) in Montenegro, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: Na propratnom pismu jasno navesti izvor prijave (spontana prijava/prijava iz neintervencijske studije/literature/ostalo) i podatak o primarnom izvještaču, za medicinski potvrđene prijave. Ukoliko se radi o prijavi iz studije, navesti i tačan naziv studije;
rows.review_note: Review: as point 3. Translation check: agrees.
rows.quote_en: On the cover letter, clearly state the source of the report (spontaneous report/report from a non-interventional study/literature/other) and the information on the primary reporter, for medically confirmed reports. If it is a report from a study, also state the exact name of the study;

f.title: Use e-mail only exceptionally out of hours for serious unexpected ADRs, then file via the archive
f.statement: Only in exceptional cases (reporting of suspected serious unexpected adverse drug reactions) outside the Institute's working hours may the person responsible for pharmacovigilance in Montenegro submit the report by e-mail; the report must then also be submitted through the Institute's archive (registry office).
f.applicability: Suspected serious unexpected ADRs outside the Institute's working hours
f.exceptions: E-mail submission does not replace the mandatory subsequent submission through the archive.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (or MA applicant) in Montenegro, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: Samo u izuzetnim slučajevima (prijavljivanje sumnji na ozbiljne neočekivane neželjene reakcije na ljekove), van radnog vremena Instituta, odgovorna osoba za farmakovigilancu u Crnoj Gori prijavu može dostaviti putem e-maila, uz naknadno, obavezno dostavljanje prijave preko arhive;
rows.review_note: Review: level Permitted for the e-mail route ('može'); the follow-up archive filing is 'obavezno' and is part of the condition. Translation check: agrees.
rows.quote_en: Only in exceptional cases (reporting of suspected serious unexpected adverse drug reactions), outside the Institute's working hours, the person responsible for pharmacovigilance in Montenegro may submit the report by e-mail, with subsequent mandatory submission of the report through the archive;

f.title: Do not resubmit Institute-originated reports on CIOMS or E2B unless requested
f.statement: Reports that the MAH or MA applicant receives from the Institute on the Institute's form need not be resubmitted on the CIOMS form or in E2B format, except at the Institute's request.
f.exceptions: Resubmission is required when the Institute requests it.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (or MA applicant) in Montenegro, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: Prijave koje nosilac dozvole/podnosilac zahtjeva za dobijanje dozvole primi od Instituta, na obrascu Instituta, nije potrebno ponovo dostavljati na CIOMS obrascu, odnosno E2B formatu prijave, osim na zahtjev Instituta;
rows.review_note: Review: 'nije potrebno' (not necessary) = Permitted. Translation check: agrees.
rows.quote_en: Reports which the marketing authorisation holder/applicant for a marketing authorisation receives from the Institute, on the Institute's form, need not be resubmitted on the CIOMS form or in the E2B report format, except at the request of the Institute;

f.title: Search and continuously monitor local and international medical literature, including congress abstracts
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders in Montenegro must search and continuously monitor the relevant local and international medical literature as an important source of medicine safety information, including relevant published papers and abstracts from scientific and professional meetings. Literature cases are reported within the deadlines and in the manner set by local regulations and this instruction.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Nosioci dozvole za lijek u Crnoj Gori su u obavezi da pretražuju i kontinuirano prate lokalnu i međunarodnu relevantnu medicinsku literaturu, kao značajan izvor informacija o bezbjednosti ljekova, uključujući i relevantne publikovane radove/apstrakte sa održanih naučnih i stručnih skupova.
rows.review_note: Review: 'su u obavezi' = are obliged. Translation check: agrees.
rows.quote_en: Holders of a marketing authorisation for a medicine in Montenegro are obliged to search and continuously monitor the relevant local and international medical literature, as an important source of information on the safety of medicines, including relevant published papers/abstracts from scientific and professional meetings held.

f.title: Submit literature cases with cover letter, form, E2B report and the publication
f.statement: For an adverse reaction case described in the literature, together with the cover letter and the generated report (on the Institute's form or the CIOMS form), the MAH must submit the electronic report (E2B format) and the published paper (if available to the MAH).
f.exceptions: The published paper only if available to the MAH.

rows.quote: Uz propratno pismo i generisanu prijavu (popunjenu na obrascu Instituta ili CIOMS obrascu ) nosilac dozvole je u obavezi da dostavi elektronsku prijavu (E2B format) i publikovani rad (ukoliko je dostupan nosiocu dozvole).
rows.review_note: Review: 'je u obavezi' = is obliged. Translation check: agrees.
rows.quote_en: Together with the cover letter and the generated report (completed on the Institute form or the CIOMS form), the marketing authorisation holder is obliged to submit the electronic report (E2B format) and the published paper (if available to the marketing authorisation holder).
